entities.summary: Maysa Figueira Monjardim, better known as Maysa Matarazzo, was a Brazilian singer-songwriter, performer and actress. She is also associated with Bossa nova music but is widely known as a torch song (fossa) interpreter. Maysa Matarazzo was a composers & musicians from São Paulo (1936-06-06, São Paulo–1977-01-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
